# Test pe optimize command - prompt optimization

# Basic optimization with standard method
env PE_TEST_MODE=true
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --provider mock --iterations 2
stdout 'Optimization Results'
stdout 'Original Prompt:'
stdout 'Optimized Prompt:'
stdout 'Improvement Score:'
exists prompt_standard.txt

# PE2 optimization
env PE_TEST_MODE=true
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --method pe2 --iterations 2 --provider mock
stdout 'Optimization Results'
stdout 'Iteration Details'
exists prompt_pe2.txt

# TextGrad optimization
env PE_TEST_MODE=true
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --method textgrad --iterations 2 --provider mock
stdout 'Optimization Results'
exists prompt_textgrad.txt

# APEX optimization
env PE_TEST_MODE=true
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --method apex --iterations 2 --provider mock
stdout 'Optimization Results'
exists prompt_apex.txt

# Hybrid optimization
env PE_TEST_MODE=true
exec pe optimize prompt.txt --method hybrid --iterations 2 --provider mock
stdout 'Optimization Results'
exists prompt_hybrid.txt

# Optimization with output file
env PE_TEST_MODE=true
exec pe optimize prompt.txt -o results.json --provider mock --iterations 1
stdout 'Results saved to: results.json'
exists results.json
exec grep '"original_prompt"' results.json
exec grep '"optimized_prompt"' results.json

-- prompt.txt --
Analyze the sentiment of the provided text.

-- system.json --
{
  "components": {
    "analyzer": "Analyze input",
    "summarizer": "Summarize results"
  }
}
